Posting:
{
 "posting_id": "8241508",
 "title": "3D Print Technician",
 "location": "Boston, MA"

A posting is relevant if it is a supply chain, procurement, planning or ops analyst role, entry to mid level (5 years or less), in Boston or remote.

Reply with JSON only. No prose, no code fences. Exactly these keys:
{"posting_id": "<the posting_id above>", "verdict": "relevant" or "not_relevant", "resume_fields": [names from: target_titles, skills, locations, exclude_keywords], "posting_fields": [names from: title, content, location], "justification": "<one to three sentences naming the specific terms behind the verdict>"}
